id: The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert (1994)

facts.text: Darling, even in the desert one dines properly. Sit up, we have a long drive to Alice.
facts.why: Set out as the character's own words, but the film does not have them say it. Bernadette's real lines on Wikiquote include 'Believe me, Bob, these days gentlemen are an endangered species.'.
facts.fix: Believe me, Bob, these days gentlemen are an endangered species.

fix_note.text: Believe me, Bob, these days gentlemen are an endangered species.

vibe.verdict: The Broken Hill pub and Alice trip are right, but it plays safe and skips the sequins.
